changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE user_foot ( id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, post_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, action VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT 'LIKE / COLLECT', created_time DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_user_foot (user_id, post_id, action), KEY idx_user_foot_post (post_id, action) ) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 COLLATE = utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT = '用户足迹：点赞/收藏';
